probe_method: Run existing tests that exercise failure paths; verify FAILURE never becomes SUCCESS

probes.description: Missing required configuration fails clearly (ConfigurationError with missingVars names only — never values)
probes.test_evidence: tests/mission/config-validator.test.ts (8 tests): verifies that ConfigurationError carries missingVars (names only), never the values

probes.description: Invalid config value rejected by ConfigValidator
Worker/runtime failure surfaces as failure (not success)
probes.test_evidence: tests/worker/worker-agent.test.ts + tests/worker/worker-agent-retry.test.ts: verifies WorkerResult.status='failure' on provider failure, parse failure, budget exhaustion, missing artifacts

probes.description: Verification failure surfaces as mission failure (not success)
probes.test_evidence: tests/mission/verification.test.ts + tests/mission/verification-hash-match.test.ts: verifies that failed checks cause verification.ok=false, which causes mission status=partial/failure

probes.description: Optional provider (Jev) unavailability surfaces as JevProviderUnavailableError (no silent fallback)
probes.test_evidence: tests/providers/jev-decision-provider.test.ts (32 tests): verifies missing credential, HTTP 401/403/500, network error, malformed response, invalid choice all throw typed errors; no silent fallback to Rule

probes.description: Secrets are never logged in errors, FlightRecorder, or test snapshots
probes.test_evidence: tests/mission/secret-redaction.test.ts + tests/providers/jev-decision-provider.test.ts: verifies no credential strings appear in error messages, providerMetadata, or flight records

probes.description: Hash mismatch is detected and causes verification failure (not silent acceptance)
probes.test_evidence: tests/mission/verification-hash-match.test.ts (5 tests): verifies SHA-256 hash mismatch causes verification.ok=false

probes.description: Mission cannot report success without observed work (claimed artifacts verified to exist; verification runs)
probes.test_evidence: src/worker/worker-agent.ts: worker_success_vs_failure checks claimed artifacts exist via computer.readFile; src/mission/verification.ts: clean-room copy + checks; src/mission/orchestrator.ts: mission_status logic requires verification.ok AND hasDeliverable

key_principle: FAILURE MUST NOT BECOME SUCCESS — verified across all 8 probes
